shared_elements: low-relief creature shown with splayed limbs / animals in relief
repeated geometric band or ring of regular units (toothed rim vs. row of chevrons/zigzags)
bilateral symmetry in at least one motif
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic relief creatures accompanied by a repeated band of regular geometric units and small round bosses, which is about as generic a correspondence as two carving traditions could reach independently. The organising schemes are wholly different: A is a radially symmetric disc with concentric rings enclosing a single central arachnid-like body, while B stacks horizontal registers of profile quadrupeds, birds and a handled object down a rectangular field, with no shared specific motif or relationship.
